summary: On Sundays the Mezquita-Catedral is closed to tourist visits from about 11:30 to 15:00 for Mass, exactly when the plan has you in Córdoba (13:00–14:00), so change the Córdoba stop. Weather is dry and sunny with light wind, and it is general election day (no driving restrictions).

items.title: Mezquita closed to visitors at midday on Sunday
items.detail: Sunday tourist visits run about 08:30–11:30 and 15:00–18:00, with Masses at midday, so a 13:00–14:00 stop will not get inside. Either swap the order (Córdoba first, arriving before 11:00, then Antequera by 14:15) or stay in Córdoba until 15:00 and leave about an hour later; otherwise see only the outside and the Patio de los Naranjos.

items.title: Dolmens close at 15:00 on Sundays
items.detail: From mid-September to December the Dolmens site opens 09:00–15:00 on Sundays, so the planned 10:35 visit fits; if you swap the order to see the Mezquita in the morning, you must reach the dolmens by about 14:15.

items.title: Low-emission zone around the Mezquita
items.detail: Córdoba's zone around the Mezquita, Alcázar and Judería admits only 0 and ECO-label cars plus residents and hotel guests, all day every day. Unless the rental car has an ECO or 0 label, park outside it (south bank of the river or north of the centre) and walk in.

items.title: Possible lane closure after summer sinkhole repairs
items.detail: A sinkhole closed lanes on the A-45 near Casabermeja in July and repairs followed; no current status was found. Check DGT traffic before leaving and allow a few extra minutes on the Málaga–Antequera stretch.

items.title: General election on Sunday 29 Nov
items.detail: Polling stations are open 09:00–20:00 and there are no driving restrictions; expect a little more traffic and parking pressure around schools used as polling stations.

weather.wind: NW 11–14 km/h in the morning, light E in the afternoon
